symptom: ako/mxcli#533: `call microflow M.MF_B(P: $P)` is a parse error (`mismatched input ':' expecting '='`) while `show page M.P(P: $P)` and a page action/data source `M.F(P: $P)` parse with an MDL-DEPR007 warning — the same argument has a different set of accepted spellings per call site
cause: MDL-DEPR007 (`Param: e`, R4) was registered as an alias, but only showPageArg and microflowArgV3 carried the `identifierOrKeyword COLON expression` alternative; callArgument (call microflow/nanoflow/java action/javascript action/external action/web service/database query) accepted only `=`
fix: Add `parameterName COLON /* @alias MDL-DEPR007 */ expression` to callArgument; ExitCallArgument records MDL-DEPR007 with the ` = ` rewrite (recordColonArgument now takes any name context). Kept the registry's RemovedIn 2: under ADR-0011 an alias deprecated in the mdl 1 era warns under mdl 0 and mdl 1 and is refused only from mdl 2 — refusing it under mdl 1 would change the frozen mdl 1 for show page
insight: When an alias is registered, grep every rule that binds the same construct (here: every argument rule) — a registry entry names a spelling, not the rules that accept it, so the alias coverage drifts per call site
